title: Nine Centuries of Studying
subtitle: 文明与文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文明与文化（历史社会与文化·文明与文化）
meta: 主题语境：文明与文化（历史社会与文化·文明与文化）　|　核心词汇：civilisation　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 civilisation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother was sent to study ① civilisation she could not name, and she said the studying was the whole of the lesson. The ② civilisation, meaning the culture and not the city, was nine centuries old and was studied by whoever came last; civilisation, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ civilisation in that valley had the same river, and the ④ civilisation at the end, meaning the one the scholars kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever studied properly. Civilization, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ civilisation was the whole of the book, meaning the order it carried and not the culture. The ⑥ civilisation, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a book that everybody praises and nobody questions; civilisation, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a culture and an order. She said the order is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ civilisation had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the river. The ⑧ civilisation of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine centuries and eleven years of studying; civilisation, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ civilisation I remember is the one at the end, which was studied in 1969 and is still described as the oldest in the county. A ⑩ civilisation, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being studied; every civilisation, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like a culture. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 文明；文明社会
B. n. 文明（指那种文化本身，与那座城相对）
C. 固定搭配：study a civilisation 研究一种文明
D. n. 文明（指那条河谷里每一种）
E. n. 文明（指末尾那一种）
F. n. 秩序（抽象：它承载的那套秩序）
G. n. 那套秩序（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The civilisation, meaning the culture and not the city
civilisation was the whole of the book
the civilisation had become a number in a report
The civilisation of the whole thing
A civilisation, my grandmother said in 1974

answers.why: study a civilisation 意为“研究一种文明”，1949 年母亲被派去研究她叫不出名字的那种文明。
civilisation 意为“文明”，指那种文化本身而不是那座城，有九百年历史，由最后来的人研究。
civilisation 指那条河谷里每一种文明，每一种都是同样的河流。
civilisation 指末尾那一种（学者保留的那一种），是唯一有人认真研究过的。
civilisation 意为“秩序”，抽象指它承载的那套秩序，父亲说 civilisation 就是那本书的全部。
civilisation 为抽象用法，指那套秩序本身，是一本书里人人都称赞、却没人质疑的东西。
civilisation 意为“文明”，到 1964 年这种 civilisation 成了报告里的一个数字。
civilisation 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个世纪和十一年的研究。
civilisation 意为“文明”，我记得的是末尾那一种，1969 年研究过，至今仍被说成全县最古老的。
civilisation 为抽象总称，祖母说一种文明是唯一会因为被认真研究而变好的东西。

那种文明，指的是那种文化本身而不是那座城，有九百年历史，由最后来的人研究。（civilisation）

父亲说 civilisation 就是那本书的全部，指的是它承载的秩序而不是那种文化。（civilisation）
1974 年祖母说，一种文明是唯一会因为被认真研究而变好的东西。（civilisation）

Every civilisation in that valley had the same river.
The civilisation at the end, meaning the one the scholars kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever studied properly.
